The '''VX Vibro-greatsword''', also known as the '''Czerhander''', was a type of [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] produced by the weapon-manufacturer [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]], and available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The sword was extended in both blade and hilt length compared to other models of vibrosword, and as such were also heavier. The hilt allowed for the weapon to be wielded with two hands, giving the user greater control and resulting in many skilled swordsman favoring the weapon. The sword equalled a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] in terms of hitting power, and despite its weight and size was well balanced enough to parry with. The weapon cost 900 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and during the war was rare enough that it was hard to find.<ref name="DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The VX Vibro-greatsword was first mentioned in ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]'' a sourcebook released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]] for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
